architecture.philosophy: Empirical evidence over model declarations. Return codes or model claims alone can never satisfy side-effecting or semantic predicates.

tiers.description: Evaluates workstation state immediately following individual capability execution.

strategies.RETURN_CODE_ONLY: Fail-closed rejected as dispatch-only for any task requiring persistent state, files, or UI.
strategies.FILE_EXISTS: Confirms physical presence on filesystem using Path.exists().
strategies.FILE_NON_EMPTY: Confirms physical presence and non-zero byte size on disk.
strategies.FILE_CONTAINS: Reads disk file content directly and verifies exact or substring match.
strategies.WINDOW_READY: Queries Win32 user32.IsWindow and IsWindowVisible for target HWND, or WindowDiscovery by title.
strategies.WINDOW_CLOSED: Confirms target HWND no longer exists in Win32 window table.
strategies.NETWORK_SSID: Queries WLAN API to confirm active SSID connection match.

tiers.description: Evaluates end-to-end goal contract acceptance predicates against physical workstation state.
tiers.provenance_binding: Injects active run_id and task_id directly into predicate evidence to ensure trace integrity.

tiers.description: Final gatekeeper verifying that all mandatory predicates have affirmative satisfaction, valid provenance, no stale markers, no FAILED_CLEANUP, and required physical presentation.

invariants: Planner derives VerifierStrategy from GoalContract acceptance predicates, never defaulting to RETURN_CODE_ONLY for artifact-producing tasks.
File tasks require affirmative disk reads with content/size checks.
Presentation tasks require physical window handle identity and visibility (RESULT_PRESENTED), never mere request.
Cleanup tasks require valid resource identity and absence of FAILED_CLEANUP.
